headline: Meta Expands Nvidia Deal for Millions of AI Chips in Massive DC Build-Out
summary: Meta struck a deal worth tens of billions with Nvidia to deploy millions of GPUs and standalone Grace CPUs across its AI data centers, part of up to $135B in 2026 AI spending.

headline: Meta Secures 6.6 GW of Nuclear Power With TerraPower, Oklo, and Vistra
summary: Meta signed 20-year agreements with three nuclear providers for 6.6 GW of power, including immediate access to existing plants and support for new SMR facilities by 2032.

headline: OpenAI Taps SB Energy to Build 1.2 GW Data Center in Texas
summary: OpenAI selected SB Energy to build a 1.2 GW data center in Milam County, Texas — one of the largest single-site AI compute campuses in the world.

headline: Google Taps Geothermal Power for Nevada Data Centers
summary: Google is investing in geothermal energy for its Nevada DC operations, pursuing 24/7 carbon-free baseload power to meet continuous AI workload demands.

headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 4.6 With 1M Token Context Window
summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 4.6 with a million-token context window, improved instruction following, and long-context reasoning across all platforms.

headline: OpenClaw's Rise: From Weekend Experiment to OpenAI Acquisition
summary: OpenClaw became the fastest-growing open source AI project before being acquihired by OpenAI. Its creator now leads personal agent development at OpenAI.

headline: Global Data Center Capex Approaching $1 Trillion in 2026
summary: Global DC capex is expected to approach $1T in 2026. Top four US hyperscalers have combined capex near $600B, with 35+ GW under construction in North America and vacancy at 1%.

headline: Colorado Mandates 100% Renewable Power for Large Data Centers by 2031
summary: Colorado SB26-102 requires data centers with 30+ MW peak load to source 100% renewable electricity by 2031 with hourly matching. Illinois follows with mandatory impact assessments.

headline: CSET Publishes Reports on Physical AI and China's Military AI Ambitions
summary: Georgetown CSET released 'Physical AI' on AI-robotics convergence and 'China's Military AI Wish List' analyzing PLA procurement documents revealing AI-enabled military ambitions.
